info.title: Micropod API · SystemService
info.description:
## micropod.v1.SystemService

Daemon-level operations: runtime snapshot, cleanup usage report, and the
 desktop app's update lifecycle (proxied over the app control socket).

post.description:
Quit the app so a downloaded update installs and relaunches. Fails
 with `failed_precondition` until `UpdateStatus.ready_to_install`.

Trigger a background update check in the desktop app (Sparkle).
 Fails with `unavailable` when the app isn't running.

Resource usage over time for all containers ("system"), one container,
 or one machine, as recorded by the Micropod app (every 5 s while its
 window is open, 30 s otherwise). Rolled up and pruned by age: 10 s
 points for 3 h, 1 min for 48 h, 15 min for 30 days — the finest that
 covers the range is returned. A container's or machine's history is
 deleted with it.
Last-known updater status from the desktop app.

What a cleanup would reclaim: images and volumes annotated with the
 containers that reference them.

Execution engines this server can drive, with availability,
 capabilities and which one is the default for new containers.

Millisecond liveness: runtime status and active backend without disk
 usage. Answers `status: stopped` (never an error) when the runtime is
 down but the API server is up.

Persist the engine new containers run on when RunContainerRequest
 leaves `runtime` unset. Fails with `failed_precondition` for an
 unknown or unavailable engine.

Enable/disable an engine or point it at a different endpoint (e.g. the
 Docker engine at an OrbStack or colima socket). Disabled engines are
 left out of ListContainers and refuse RunContainer. The default engine
 cannot be disabled (`failed_precondition`). Persisted server-side.

connect-protocol-version.title: Connect-Protocol-Version
connect-protocol-version.description: Define the version of the Connect protocol

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is no limit on the number of messages.

type.description: A URL that acts as a globally unique identifier for the type of the serialized message. For example: `type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo`. This is used to determine the schema of the data in the `value` field and is the discriminator for the `debug` field.

value.description: The Protobuf message, serialized as bytes and base64-encoded. The specific message type is identified by the `type` field.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Deserialized error detail payload. The 'type' field indicates the schema. This field is for easier debugging and should not be relied upon for application logic.

connect.error_details.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message, with an additional debug field for ConnectRPC error details.

cpuPercent.title: cpu_percent
cpuPercent.description: CPU usage as a percentage of one core.

networkRxBytes.title: network_rx_bytes
networkRxBytes.description: Bytes received over the container network.

networkTxBytes.title: network_tx_bytes
networkTxBytes.description: Bytes transmitted over the container network.

blockReadBytes.title: block_read_bytes
blockReadBytes.description: Bytes read from the block device.

blockWriteBytes.title: block_write_bytes
blockWriteBytes.description: Bytes written to the block device.

pids.title: pids
pids.description: Number of processes inside the container.

cpuUsageUsec.title: cpu_usage_usec
cpuUsageUsec.description:
Cumulative CPU time consumed by the container since it started, in
 microseconds (cgroup `cpu.stat` usage_usec), summed across cores.
 Exact on every sample, including the first one for an id (unlike
 `cpu_percent`, which is a delta and reads 0 until a baseline exists),
 so callers can compute their own rates. 0 = not reported by the
 backend (the Docker engine reports its own `cpu_usage.total_usage`
 converted from nanoseconds).

oomKillCount.title: oom_kill_count
oomKillCount.description:
Processes in the container killed by the kernel OOM killer since it
 started (cgroup `memory.events` oom_kill), read from the guest agent.
 Unset = not reported (CLI and Docker backends, a guest agent that did
 not answer in time, or one without memory-event support); a set 0
 means "read, no OOM kills". Native backend only.

micropod.v1.ContainerStats.title: ContainerStats
micropod.v1.ContainerStats.description: Per-container resource counters within a StatsSnapshot.

active.title: active
active.description: Objects currently referenced by a running workload.

sizeBytes.title: size_bytes
sizeBytes.description: On-disk size of the category in bytes.

reclaimableBytes.title: reclaimable_bytes
reclaimableBytes.description: Bytes freed if inactive objects were pruned.

totalReclaimableBytes.title: total_reclaimable_bytes
totalReclaimableBytes.description: Bytes reclaimable by pruning across all categories.

micropod.v1.DiskUsage.title: DiskUsage
micropod.v1.DiskUsage.description: Disk usage, mapped from `container system df`.

micropod.v1.Empty.title: Empty
micropod.v1.Empty.description:
The Micropod daemon API is grouped into per-domain services, one per file:

   container.proto — ContainerService (lifecycle, logs, stats, exec)
   image.proto     — ImageService (list, pull, delete)
   volume.proto    — VolumeService (volumes + mount policy)
   network.proto   — NetworkService
   compose.proto   — Compose (up/down over a compose spec)
   system.proto    — SystemService (snapshot, usage, app updates)

 Empty is shared by every service, so it lives here.

id.title: id
id.description: Container id or machine name; ignored for "system".

rangeSeconds.title: range_seconds
rangeSeconds.description: How far back, in seconds (0 = one hour; at most 30 days).

names.title: names
names.description: All tags/references pointing at this image.

micropod.v1.Image.title: Image
micropod.v1.Image.description: Curated view of a local image, mapped from `container image list --verbose`.

micropod.v1.ImageVariant.title: ImageVariant
micropod.v1.ImageVariant.description: One platform variant of a multi-arch image.

points.title: points
points.description: Oldest first; empty when nothing was recorded in the range.

cpuPercent.title: cpu_percent
cpuPercent.description: CPU % (100 = one core): average and peak.

memoryUsedBytes.title: memory_used_bytes
memoryUsedBytes.description: Memory in use (bytes): average and peak.

networkRxBytesPerSecond.title: network_rx_bytes_per_second
networkRxBytesPerSecond.description: Network and disk rates (bytes per second), averages.

micropod.v1.MetricsPoint.title: MetricsPoint
micropod.v1.MetricsPoint.description: One bucket: averages, plus the peak of the metrics that spike.

runtimeBackend.title: runtime_backend
runtimeBackend.description: Backend the API server is currently driving: "native" (XPC) or "cli".

apiServerVersion.title: api_server_version
apiServerVersion.description: Version of the embedded API server.

features.title: features
features.description:
Optional request capabilities this server honours, so clients can
 detect them instead of sending fields an older server would silently
 ignore (proto3 drops unknown fields). Names are the
 `RunContainerRequest` field names: "cap_add", "cap_drop", "rosetta",
 "privileged". Empty on servers that predate the list.

defaultRuntime.title: default_runtime
defaultRuntime.description:
Engine RunContainer uses when `runtime` is unset (see ListRuntimes).
 Empty on servers that predate engine selection.

micropod.v1.PingResponse.title: PingResponse
micropod.v1.PingResponse.description: Cheap liveness reply for detection and health ticks (see Ping).

username.title: username
username.description: Account username stored for the registry.

scheme.title: scheme
scheme.description: Auth scheme in use, e.g. "basic" or "oauth".

micropod.v1.RegistryLogin.title: RegistryLogin
micropod.v1.RegistryLogin.description: A registry login, mapped from `container registry list`.

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
What kind of isolation it provides: "vm" (micro-VM per container via
 a runtime daemon), "microvm" (in-process ephemeral micro-VM) or
 "container" (shared-kernel containers inside one VM).

available.title: available
available.description: True when the engine can take work right now.

reason.title: reason
reason.description: Why it is unavailable (empty when available).

endpoint.title: endpoint
endpoint.description: Where the engine lives: a socket path, install root or state dir.

default.title: default
default.description: Default engine for RunContainer when `runtime` is unset.

capabilities.title: capabilities
capabilities.description:
Container operations the engine supports: "run", "create", "start",
 "stop", "kill", "delete", "exec", "logs", "stats", "ports", "volumes".
 Calls outside this set fail with `unimplemented`.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description:
Enabled engines contribute to ListContainers and accept RunContainer.
 "docker" starts disabled so an existing Docker Desktop's containers
 don't appear until asked for.

containers.title: containers
containers.description: Per-container stats, one entry per running container.

sampledAt.title: sampled_at
sampledAt.description: ISO8601 timestamp the snapshot was taken.

micropod.v1.StatsSnapshot.title: StatsSnapshot
micropod.v1.StatsSnapshot.description:
Single snapshot of runtime resource usage for all running containers,
 mapped from `container stats --no-stream --format json`.

diskUsage.title: disk_usage
diskUsage.description: Disk usage grouped by resource kind.

appRoot.title: app_root
appRoot.description: Path to the installed Micropod.app bundle.

apiServerVersion.title: api_server_version
apiServerVersion.description: Version of the embedded API server.

runtimeBackend.title: runtime_backend
runtimeBackend.description: Backend the API server is currently driving: "native" (XPC) or "cli".

micropod.v1.SystemStatus.title: SystemStatus
micropod.v1.SystemStatus.description: Runtime health, mapped from `container system status`.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Enable or disable the engine; unset leaves it unchanged.

endpoint.title: endpoint
endpoint.description:
Engine endpoint override; empty string restores the default. Docker:
 "unix:///path/docker.sock" or "tcp://host:port" (plain HTTP). Other
 engines reject an endpoint with `invalid_argument`.

feedConfigured.title: feed_configured
feedConfigured.description: Whether a Sparkle feed URL is configured.

availableVersion.title: available_version
availableVersion.description: Version available on the feed, if an update was found.

downloaded.title: downloaded
downloaded.description: True once an update has finished downloading.

readyToInstall.title: ready_to_install
readyToInstall.description: True when ApplyUpdate will succeed immediately.

error.title: error
error.description: Last updater error, when `state` is STATE_ERROR.

checkedAt.title: checked_at
checkedAt.description: ISO8601 time of the last completed check.

micropod.v1.UpdateStatus.title: UpdateStatus
micropod.v1.UpdateStatus.description:
Desktop-app updater status (Sparkle), proxied over the app control
 socket. Reported by CheckForUpdates, GetUpdateStatus, and ApplyUpdate.

images.title: images
images.description: Every local image with its referencing containers.

volumes.title: volumes
volumes.description: Every local volume with its mounting containers.

reclaimableImageBytes.title: reclaimable_image_bytes
reclaimableImageBytes.description: Bytes reclaimable by pruning unreferenced images.

reclaimableVolumeBytes.title: reclaimable_volume_bytes
reclaimableVolumeBytes.description: Bytes reclaimable by pruning unmounted volumes.

micropod.v1.UsageReport.title: UsageReport
micropod.v1.UsageReport.description:
What a cleanup would reclaim: every image and volume annotated with the
 containers that reference it.

usedByContainerIds.title: used_by_container_ids
usedByContainerIds.description: IDs of containers referencing this image.

inUse.title: in_use
inUse.description: True when at least one container references the image.

micropod.v1.UsageReport.ImageUsage.title: ImageUsage
micropod.v1.UsageReport.ImageUsage.description: An image plus the containers that reference it.

usedByContainerIds.title: used_by_container_ids
usedByContainerIds.description: IDs of containers mounting this volume.

inUse.title: in_use
inUse.description: True when at least one container mounts the volume.

micropod.v1.UsageReport.VolumeUsage.title: VolumeUsage
micropod.v1.UsageReport.VolumeUsage.description: A volume plus the containers mounting it.

allocatedBytes.title: allocated_bytes
allocatedBytes.description:
Bytes actually allocated on disk by the backing image (st_blocks × 512).
 `size_bytes` is the provisioned size; sparse images allocate far less.

micropod.v1.Volume.title: Volume
micropod.v1.Volume.description: Curated volume, mapped from `container volume list`.
